# nanoseconds; sent indices start at zero, shared IDs at one
S 0 1280 0 0
S 10000000 1280 1280 0
A 15000000 1000000 0 0 85333 15000000 1280 1280 0 0 1280 0 0 1
S 20000000 1280 1280 0
S 30000000 1280 2560 0
# The 30 ms send interval dominates the 16 ms ACK interval.
A 31000000 1000000 0 3,2 85333 30000000 2560 2560 1280 0 3840 0 0 4
S 40000000 1280 1280 0
# Now the 49 ms ACK interval dominates the 10 ms send interval.
A 80000000 1000000 0 4 26122 49000000 1280 1280 3840 0 2560 0 0 5
E 80000000 0 4,3,2
